demo.title: Demo approval
demo.description: This payment uses the demo rail. No real charge will be made.
demo.note: The signed webhook goes through the real inbox, queue and state machine.

hero.subtitle: A working gateway showcase, not a slide deck. Stripe, PawaPay and a local mock rail behind one adapter contract, with signed webhooks, idempotency, PostgreSQL and a BullMQ worker.

mock.description: Signed webhooks, USSD-style approval, deterministic failures.

stripe.description: Payment Element, signed events, idempotent refunds.

providerStrategy.description: The API never branches on provider names. It resolves a registry entry and speaks the same typed interface.

invariant.quote: “Exactly one transition is written, even with concurrent duplicate callbacks.”
invariant.description: PostgreSQL inbox, BullMQ retries and an explicit state machine.

pipeline.description: Every callback is verified against the raw body, persisted before the queue, then applied by one worker.
pipeline.ctaDescription: The Mock rail needs no credentials. Approve the payment and watch the signed webhook move through the inbox, the queue and the state machine.

signature.title: Signature first
signature.body: Raw body verification before a single row is written.

inbox.title: Inbox before queue
inbox.body: PostgreSQL persists the event before BullMQ sees it. Redis can fail safely.

state.title: Explicit state machine
state.body: No backward transitions, no terminal overwrites, no double credit.

idempotent.title: Idempotent everywhere
idempotent.body: Client keys, provider event ids and SQL constraints all agree.
